review:
Spinman is a superhero-themed payline slot where the hero's own symbol expands into a full Justice Reel wild whenever it would complete a win. Every expansion spins a Booster Wheel that gives the reel one of six multipliers between 2x and 500x, or an instant max win, and several Justice Reels in one win add their values together.

Beyond the three standard bonus rounds there's a Hidden Epic Bonus called Reel Heroes, which can't be bought and only triggers naturally in the base game. That makes ordinary base spins a little more exciting than usual. The cap is 10,000x.
